about: RO1 reference, NOT client evidence (inferred, docs/research/world-core-evidence.md). The server makes a field monster attack on sight when its NPCConfig _iAI is 20000004 (MonsterService.AggressiveAi, three field monsters); with the switch on, the monsters below attack on sight too because their Ragnarok Online 1 counterpart does. Source: rAthena's pre-renewal monster database https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rathena/rathena/master/db/pre-re/mob_db.yml and its mode reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rathena/rathena/master/doc/mob_db_mode_list.txt, both fetched 2026-10-28. A RO1 monster is aggressive when its Modes set Aggressive, otherwise when its Aegis Ai type maps to a mode with MD_AGGRESSIVE (0x4): 04, 05, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 26, 27. Field monsters are NPCConfig rows with _iNPCType 1 that a scene editor spawns (m_kWorldMonsterSpawnPoints / m_kWorldMonsterSpawnGroups) or that have _iWildMonsters 1. They are matched by English name (NPCConfig _kName in Localization_en), case-insensitive and exact, to exactly one RO1 entry; a name with several RO1 entries or none is listed under unmatched with the reason, not guessed. The renewal database (db/re/mob_db.yml) agrees with pre-renewal on every matched monster. Counts: 21 aggressive (monsters), 38 matched but not aggressive in RO1 (notAggressive), 164 unmatched. Switch: Ro3Emu:Ro1AggressiveMonsters (off by default). Never mixed into client data. A name with several rAthena entries counts when every entry is aggressive. Bosses and elites (NPCConfig _iNPCSubType other than 1) are left out (listed under bosses): their fights keep the client's own AI.
